summary: Iteration 38 e2e testing of SaaS panel split (/sistem/*), Stripe subscription checkout (emergentintegrations), license reminders, public /fiyatlar + /kayit signup, and platform settings. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases PASS (auth gating, public plans/signup, Stripe checkout+status, reminders d1/dedupe/expired+lock, platform settings PUT/GET, regression on comp_nexus_main_01). Frontend: /sistem unauthenticated redirects to /sistem/giris (system-login-page); sales user login blocked with 'yalnızca süper admin' error (sys-login-error); super admin login shows system-layout + all 8 sys-nav items; company rows, saas-payments+pay-total, reminders-run, saas-settings all render; sys-logout returns to /sistem/giris. ERP side: super admin login shows sidebar-system-panel-link but NO 'Sistem Yönetimi' item in main nav; sales user has no system-panel link. /fiyatlar shows 4 pricing-cards, pricing-billing-y toggle works, pricing-start-plan_standard → /kayit?plan=plan_standard; signup-plan-summary shows 'Standart'; signup with unique email → signup-success → signup-go-app → ERP '/' with license-badge 'Standart · Deneme 14 gün' and Standart module set (no /ecommerce). plan-pay-plan_pro redirects to checkout.stripe.com; /odeme/iptal shows payment-result 'Ödeme iptal edildi'. Stripe hosted checkout completion not exercised (per spec, optional).
critical_code_review_comments: saas_billing.public_signup ignores req.plan_id when plan is NOT public — falls back to settings.trial_plan_id silently. Acceptable but if a user posts an invalid plan_id, they might land on a different plan without any warning. Consider 400 on unknown plan_id.
saas_billing.public_signup logs the user in via Set-Cookie but does NOT clear login_attempts for the new email; not a bug (new account, fresh identifier) — just noting for future.

run_reminders keys license_reminders by 'company_id|kind|end_date' (period_end[:10]); if trial_ends_at is updated on the same day and re-run, dedupe stops re-send. Fine for prod, but during manual testing of extending trials, remember to bust license_reminders manually.
saas_billing.settings() merges DEFAULT_SETTINGS with DB doc; PUT /system/settings silently ignores unknown keys (good). trial_days clamped 0..90.
Stripe checkout: metadata carries company_id/plan_id/period; _apply_payment is idempotent via {applied:{$ne:true}} guard. Nice.

get_current_user (server.py:115) falls back to admin@nexus.com when no token — /auth/me relies on request cookies/headers directly to compute 'authenticated' flag. Works, but note that ANY protected endpoint without a token still resolves to admin — /api/system/* is safe because require_super_admin re-checks cookie/bearer. Other endpoints (e.g., /api/invoices) will happily serve the demo admin session. Confirmed intentional but worth documenting.

seed_data_creation: Left in DB (harmless): TEST_Signup_* + testreg_* companies with expired/trial licenses, one Stripe test session_id in payment_transactions (status=initiated,unpaid). Main company comp_nexus_main_01 verified unchanged: plan_enterprise/active/module_overrides={}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests with `-o addopts=''` to disable pytest-xdist parallelism because iteration38 tests share module-scope state (session cookies, session_id, company_id) between classes. Signup uses plan_id=plan_standard (14-day trial). To exercise Stripe completion end-to-end, would need to render checkout.stripe.com inside Playwright; skipped per spec. /odeme/basarili polls /api/payments/status/{sid} — cannot flip to paid without a real Stripe test card interaction or webhook. Public plans/signup do NOT require auth; system/* endpoints require cookie OR Bearer.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
